title: AI Product Governance Kit: AI Risk Register, AI PRD Template, Evaluation Plan, Vendor Questions and Launch Gate, Excel and Word
description:
Ship the AI feature with the paperwork already done. The AI Product Governance Kit takes one feature from "should we?" to a launch decision with its reasons, in a workbook and a Word template.

What it does for you:
• Intake: 10 yes or no questions set the risk tier and list what that tier needs
• AI PRD: 13 sections with guidance, including the "never" rules a test can check
• Risk Register: likelihood x impact, before and after mitigation, with owners and a check column
• Heat Map: where your risks sit, before and after mitigation
• Eval Plan: write the threshold first, then enter the result. Pass or fail is worked out
• Vendor Questions: 34 questions on data, model, security, reliability, legal, cost and exit
• Launch Gate: reads every tab and gives GO, GO WITH CONDITIONS or NO GO, with the reasons
• Built around the four functions of the NIST AI Risk Management Framework: Govern, Map, Measure and Manage

What's in the download:
• The governance workbook: a Sample worked on a made-up grocer, and a Blank for your feature
• The AI PRD template in Word, plus the full worked example
• A 5-page guide: quick start, framework map, printable vendor questions and a one-page launch gate

Good to know:
• Works in Excel 2019 or newer, Microsoft 365 and Google Sheets; Word, Google Docs or Pages
• Generic and fictional: no real company's material
• A planning tool, not legal advice or a certification. Check the rules where you operate
• Made with AI assistance, then built and checked by hand
• Digital download, nothing ships

From Steadfold.
